title: Luxury & Leisure at Al Marjan Island, UAE  | DarGlobal
description: Explore Al Marjan Island, UAE: pristine beaches, luxury resorts, and top-tier entertainment, including the upcoming WYNN Resort and Casino.
text: Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE In the azure waters of the Arabian Gulf, Al Marjan Island is a premier destination in Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), UAE, offering an exquisite blend of luxury, leisure, and natural beauty. This man-made archipelago, consisting of four coral-shaped islands, provides an idyllic setting for both residents and visitors seeking a unique lifestyle experience. From pristine beaches and luxury resorts to world-class entertainment and dining, Al Marjan Island is a haven for those who appreciate the finer things in life. A Paradise of Luxury Living Al Marjan Island is synonymous with luxury living. Its strategic location, just 60 minutes from Dubai, makes it a convenient retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. The island boasts a collection of high-end residential developments, luxury hotels, and resorts that cater to discerning tastes. Whether you are looking for a permanent residence or a vacation home, Al Marjan Island offers a range of properties that embody elegance and sophistication. Discover the Wonders of Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is not just about luxurious living; it is also a destination for leisure and entertainment. The island offers a plethora of attractions and activities that cater to every desire, making it a perfect getaway for families, couples, and solo travelers. The WYNN Resort and Casino One of the most anticipated attractions on Al Marjan Island is the upcoming WYNN Resort and Casino. This world-class entertainment complex will be the first casino in the UAE, bringing a new level of excitement to the island. The WYNN Resort will offer a range of gaming options, luxury accommodations, fine dining, and entertainment, making it a premier destination for those seeking an upscale and thrilling experience. Pristine Beaches and Marine Activities Al Marjan Island is renowned for its pristine beaches, where visitors can bask in the sun and enjoy the crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf. The island’s diverse marine life makes it a haven for snorkeling and diving enthusiasts. For those who prefer to stay above water, kayaking, paddleboarding, and jet skiing are popular activities. The serene environment and stunning sunsets add to the allure of this coastal paradise. Al Marjan Island offers a variety of dining options, from casual eateries to fine dining establishments. The island’s restaurants serve a diverse array of cuisines, catering to different tastes and preferences. Whether you are craving Middle Eastern delicacies, international dishes, or fresh seafood, you will find a restaurant that satisfies your palate. The Al Marjan Island Boulevard and Promenade are popular spots for shopping and dining, offering a mix of retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants in a scenic setting. For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, Al Marjan Island provides a range of recreational activities. The island’s lush landscapes and well-maintained paths are perfect for jogging, cycling, and leisurely walks. The Al Marjan Island Amphitheater hosts a variety of events and performances, adding to the island’s vibrant atmosphere. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy a round at the nearby Al Hamra Golf Club, which offers a challenging course and stunning views. A Convenient and Accessible Location Al Marjan Island’s location makes it easily accessible from major cities and airports. It is just 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport and 60 minutes from Dubai Mall and the Dubai International Financial Centre. This proximity allows residents and visitors to enjoy the best of both worlds – the tranquility of island living and the excitement of the city. The Astera : A Pinnacle of Luxury and Leisure At the heart of Al Marjan Island’s luxury offerings is The Astera, an exclusive residential project by DarGlobal in collaboration with the legendary automotive brand Aston Martin. The Astera redefines luxury living with its meticulously crafted interiors by Aston Martin, offering an unparalleled blend of elegance, innovation, and craftsmanship. Exceptional Design and Craftsmanship The Astera’s interiors, inspired by Aston Martin’s sleek and dynamic automotive designs, feature elegant lines, premium materials, and a sophisticated aesthetic. Each detail, from fine leather and polished metals to exotic woods, reflects Aston Martin’s legacy of excellence. The residences are designed to harmonize with the surrounding landscape, ensuring breathtaking views from every angle. Residents of The Astera enjoy a bespoke lifestyle experience that embodies the essence of luxury living. The Astera offers a range of world-class amenities designed for relaxation and rejuvenation. These include an infinity pool with stunning ocean views, a fitness center, an indoor cinema, a multipurpose hall, a yoga lawn, and a spa. With direct beach access, lush green spaces, and a scenic walk track, every aspect of The Astera is crafted to cater to the discerning few who seek the pinnacle of luxury living. In addition to The Astera, Al Marjan Island is home to several luxury resorts and hotels, each offering unique experiences and top-notch services. The DoubleTree by Hilton Resort & Spa, Marjan Island Resort & Spa, and the upcoming Ritz-Carlton Ras Al Khaimah, Al Hamra Beach are just a few examples of the high-end accommodations available. These resorts provide a range of amenities, including private beaches, swimming pools, spas, gourmet restaurants, and recreational activities, ensuring a memorable stay for every guest. Al Marjan Island is a testament to the UAE’s vision of creating world-class destinations that offer unparalleled luxury and leisure. From its pristine beaches and luxury resorts to its upcoming attractions like the WYNN Resort and Casino, Al Marjan Island is a haven for those seeking an exceptional lifestyle. The Astera, with its Aston Martin interiors and world-class amenities, epitomizes the island’s commitment to excellence and sophistication. Whether you are looking to invest in a luxury property or simply want to experience the best of what the UAE has to offer, Al Marjan Island is the perfect destination. Discover the luxury and leisure of Al Marjan Island, and experience a lifestyle that is truly extraordinary.

title: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Infrastructure Contract in Wadi Safar, Diriyah
description: DarGlobal has awarded a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract for the Rayana master community to Compass and Bin Omairah in Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh, marking a major milestone in the project's development.
text: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract for its ultra-exclusive Rayana community in Wadi Safar, Riyadh, to Compass and Bin Omairah Company for Contracting LLC The award marks a major milestone in the development of Rayana and reflects DarGlobal's continued progress in delivering one of Saudi Arabia's most prestigious residential destinations. The design-and-build contract covers the delivery of the primary infrastructure works supporting the Rayana community, including earthworks, roads, utility networks and access infrastructure across the development. Located within Wadi Safar, one of the most exclusive districts of Diriyah, Rayana has been carefully designed as a low-density residential enclave that prioritises privacy, space and a seamless connection with the surrounding natural landscape. The infrastructure works will establish the foundations for the community's luxury residential offering, including Rayana Mansions and the branded Trump Mansions. The community's signature Rayana Mansions and branded Trump Mansions feature expansive residences with built-up areas ranging from approximately 1,900 sqm to 7,000 sqm. Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "The award of this infrastructure contract represents an important step forward in the delivery of Rayana and reinforces our commitment to creating exceptional residential destinations in Saudi Arabia. As one of the most exclusive communities within Wadi Safar and the world, Rayana has been conceived around privacy, scale and a highly curated lifestyle experience. This milestone demonstrates the continued momentum of the project and our confidence in the long-term growth of the Kingdom's luxury real estate sector." The milestone further supports Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 objectives by contributing to the development of world-class residential destinations that attract local and international investment. Positioned within Wadi Safar, Rayana offers residents access to one of Riyadh's most sought-after lifestyle destinations, in close proximity to Diriyah, the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD), Expo 2030 and the city's future growth corridors.

title: Investing in Qatar: Right Time to Enter the Real Estate Market?

text: Investing in Qatar: Is Now the Right Time to Enter the Real Estate Market? Qatar's real estate market is experiencing a significant boom, driven by its growing economy, strategic investments in infrastructure, and its increasing appeal as a global business hub. With the recent spotlight from hosting major international events, Qatar has showcased its capability to support large-scale developments and luxury living, making it an attractive destination for investors. Each unit combines elegant design with functionality, featuring expansive living spaces, modern aesthetics, and panoramic views of the ocean. The development is equipped with state-of-the-art amenities including an infinity swimming pool, a fitness center, and dedicated concierge services, ensuring a plush lifestyle for its residents. Positioned strategically near Lusail City, The Pearl-Qatar, and Doha, residents of The Weekend 2 have easy access to Qatar’s major cultural and commercial centers. This proximity to key destinations enhances the property's rental and resale value, making it an excellent investment. The Weekend 2 represents a significant investment opportunity, thanks to its unique positioning in an emerging luxury district, coupled with Qatar’s growing demand for high-end residential units. The development promises high returns on investment through both capital appreciation and rental yields. In conclusion, Qatar’s real estate market is ripe with opportunities, making it an ideal time for investors to enter this vibrant market. Projects like The Weekend 2 by DarGlobal exemplify the luxury and innovation that are hallmarks of Qatar's real estate offerings. With its robust economy, investor-friendly laws, and ongoing infrastructural developments, Qatar is positioning itself as a leading destination for global real estate investors.

title: Luxury Villas for Sale in Marbella: A Complete Guide to the Ultimate Lifestyle
description: Discover Marbella's allure for the luxury villa: explore its rich history, and world-class amenities and know more about DarGlobal's exclusive offerings.
text: Marbella's Magnetic Charm: Why It's the Epicentre for Luxurious Villa Living Marbella, nestled on the sun-kissed Costa del Sol in southern Spain, has long been a beacon for the affluent and discerning. Its allure extends beyond its stunning beaches and vibrant nightlife, attracting those who seek a lifestyle defined by elegance, exclusivity, and a touch of Mediterranean magic. In this comprehensive guide, we'll delve into the captivating history, diverse geography, and myriad attractions that make Marbella an idyllic haven for luxury villa living. We'll also explore what to look for in a Marbella luxury villa for sale, potential pitfalls to avoid when buying such a property, and highlight DarGlobal's exquisite offerings in this sought-after region. Marbella's Evolution: From Fishing Village to Luxury Hotspot Marbella's colourful history is a captivating tale of transformation. Once little more than a humble fishing village, Marbella blossomed into a glamorous destination in the 1950s, thanks to the vision of Prince Alfonso of Hohenlohe-Langenburg . He transformed Marbella into a playground for the international jet set, attracting royalty, celebrities, and business magnates who were drawn to its natural beauty, desirable year-round sunny climate and eternal Mediterranean charm. Today, Marbella retains its timeless elegance while embracing modernity. Its historic old town, with its narrow cobblestone streets, whitewashed houses, and charming plazas, stands as a testament to its rich past. Meanwhile, the modern marina, Puerto Banús, is a hub of activity, lined with luxury yachts, high-end boutiques, and world-renowned restaurants. A Geographical Tapestry: Mountains, Sea, and Sunshine Marbella's geographical setting is a masterpiece of nature's artistry. Nestled between the Mediterranean Sea and the Sierra Blanca mountains, the town enjoys a microclimate that boasts over 320 days of sunshine a year. The Sierra Blanca mountains, with their rugged peaks and lush valleys, provide a dramatic backdrop to the town, while the glistening sky blue Mediterranean waters offer a playground for water sports enthusiasts and beach lovers alike. The town's unique geography also creates a diverse landscape, from the soft, sandy beaches of the Golden Mile to the verdant golf courses of Nueva Andalucía. Whether you prefer a beachfront villa with direct access to the sea or a mountainside retreat with panoramic views, Marbella's diverse terrain caters to every taste and preference. Marbella's Charms: A Lifestyle Beyond Compare Marbella's appeal extends beyond its natural beauty and rich history. The town offers a vibrant lifestyle that seamlessly blends relaxation and recreation, culture and cuisine, shopping and socializing. A Thriving Cultural Hub: Where Tradition Meets Modernity Marbella's cultural scene is as diverse and vibrant as its landscape. The town boasts a wealth of art galleries, museums, and historical sites that cater to a wide range of interests. Explore the charming old town, with its narrow cobblestone streets, whitewashed houses, and quaint plazas, and discover the remnants of its Moorish past. For art enthusiasts, Marbella offers a thriving contemporary art scene, with numerous galleries showcasing works by local and international artists. The Museo Ralli, a private museum showcasing Latin American art, is a must-visit for those interested in modern and contemporary works. Music lovers will find plenty to enjoy in Marbella, from intimate jazz clubs to open-air concerts featuring world-renowned performers. The Starlite Festival, a month-long summer event held in a natural amphitheatre in the hills above Marbella, attracts top international artists and has become a highlight of the cultural calendar. Gastronomic Delights: A Culinary Journey Through Spain Marbella is a culinary haven, offering a diverse array of dining experiences that cater to all tastes and budgets. From Michelin-starred restaurants helmed by celebrity chefs to traditional tapas bars serving authentic Andalusian fare, Marbella's culinary scene is a reflection of Spain's rich gastronomic heritage. Savour the freshest seafood at one of the many chiringuitos (beachfront restaurants) dotted along the coast, or indulge in a multi-course tasting menu at a fine dining establishment in the heart of the city. Sample local specialities like gambas al pil-pil (garlic shrimp), gazpacho (cold tomato soup), and paella, or venture off the beaten path to discover hidden gems where you can experience the true flavours of Spain. Shopping and Socializing: A World of Luxury and Leisure Marbella is renowned for its luxury shopping scene, with an abundance of designer boutiques, high-end brands, and exclusive shopping centres. Puerto Banús, the town's glamorous marina, is a haven for shopaholics, with its collection of designer stores, jewellers, and luxury car showrooms. But Marbella is not just about shopping; it's a social hub where the elite gather to see and be seen. The town's vibrant nightlife scene offers something for everyone, from chic cocktail bars and rooftop lounges to pulsating nightclubs and live music venues. Finding Your Dream Luxury Villa: Key Considerations and Pitfalls to Avoid When searching for luxury villas for sale in Marbella, consider the following factors: Location: Choose a location that aligns with your lifestyle preferences, whether it's a beachfront property, a golf course villa, or a secluded mountain retreat. Size and Layout: Determine the size and layout that best suits your needs, considering the number of bedrooms, bathrooms, living areas, and outdoor spaces. Amenities: Consider the amenities that are important to you, such as a private pool, spa, gym, home cinema, or wine cellar. Professional Guidance: Engage a reputable real estate agent or work with a luxury real estate developer who specializes in luxury properties in Marbella. They can help you navigate the market, negotiate the best price, and ensure a smooth transaction. Pitfalls to Watch Out For: Overpaying: Don't let the allure of Marbella cloud your judgment. Do your research, compare prices, and ensure you understand the total costs. Be aware of additional costs such as property taxes, legal fees, and renovation expenses. Factor these into your budget to avoid any surprises. Legal Complexities: Spanish property law can be complex. It's essential to engage a qualified lawyer to guide you through the legal process and protect your interests. DarGlobal: Redefining Luxury Living in Marbella DarGlobal, as a trailblazer in international luxury real estate, is making its mark on the sun-kissed shores of Marbella with two distinctive projects that redefine opulence and exclusivity. Tierra Viva Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini: This gated community of 53 bespoke villas is an architectural masterpiece, drawing inspiration from the iconic Lamborghini brand. Each villa boasts sleek lines, modern interiors, and state-of-the-art amenities, including a revolutionary in-villa car elevator. The design seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor living, with expansive terraces, infinity pools, and landscaped gardens that offer breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea. But Tierra Viva is more than just stunning aesthetics; it's an immersive lifestyle experience. Residents enjoy exclusive access to a private clubhouse with a range of leisure facilities, a state-of-the-art fitness center to maintain peak physical condition, and concierge services that cater to every whim, ensuring a life of unparalleled comfort and convenience. Marea Interiors by Missoni Step into a world of vibrant colours and luxurious textures at Marea, a collection of 2- to 4-bedroom residences within the prestigious Finca Cortesin estate. Designed in collaboration with the renowned Italian fashion house Missoni, each residence is a tapestry of bold patterns, geometric shapes, and high-end finishes. The open-plan layouts maximize natural light and flow, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for entertaining guests or relaxing with family. Marea residents are not only treated to exquisite interiors but also a wealth of amenities, including a private beach club for exclusive relaxation, a world-class spa to rejuvenate mind and body, and gourmet dining options that tantalize the taste buds. Nestled in the heart of Finca Cortesin, Marea Interiors by Missoni also offers unparalleled access to one of Spain's most exclusive golf courses, making it a haven for golf enthusiasts and luxury seekers alike. Your Gateway to Marbella's Luxury Lifestyle Owning a luxury villa in Marbella is an investment in an extraordinary lifestyle—a life where sun-drenched days are spent exploring pristine beaches, world-class golf courses, and vibrant cultural attractions. It's a life where every desire is catered to, where privacy and exclusivity are paramount, and where memories are made that will last a lifetime. Contact DarGlobal today to discover your perfect Spanish haven and start living the life you've always imagined.

title: Málaga vs. Marbella: Which City is Better for Real Estate Investment
description: Explore the real estate potential of Málaga vs. Marbella. Compare investment opportunities and market trends to determine which city offers the best options for your next property.
text: Málaga vs. Marbella: Which City is Better for Real Estate Investment Málaga and Marbella are the two most popular destinations on the Costa del Sol to invest in real estate. Both cities offer advantages, from Málaga's rising status as a top place for innovation and culture to Marbella's long-established reputation as a luxury hotspot. With so many choices available, it’s natural to wonder which city offers the best opportunities for investors. That’s why we’ve put together this blog to help you compare factors, like market trends, lifestyle offerings, and growth potential, to determine which city should be your next real estate investment. Let’s dive in and explore the possibilities with DarGlobal. This blog compares Málaga and Marbella to help investors choose the best real estate destination on Spain’s Costa del Sol. Málaga offers a blend of innovation, culture, and strong connectivity, making it ideal for professionals and tech-savvy investors. Marbella focuses on luxury living, wellness, and high-end amenities, appealing to those seeking exclusivity and a refined lifestyle. The Costa del Sol is emerging as a remote work hub, with rising demand for digital nomad properties and innovation-led growth. Investment opportunities are strong, supported by transparent regulations, rising property values, and quality developments like Marea by DarGlobal. Investors should consider local experts, lifestyle needs, and legal requirements like Spain’s Golden Visa before making a decision. Setting the Stage: A Global Shift from Uncertainty to Opportunity In recent years, a wave of change has reshaped how people think about where and how they live. Economic ups and downs, geopolitical tensions, and the long road to pandemic recovery have made many individuals and families rethink their priorities. For some, that has meant exploring new places to live that offer more stability, better opportunities, or simply a higher quality of life. At the same time, many are seeing property investment as a smart way to secure their future. Buying real estate in regions with strong tourism potential and long-term growth prospects has become a reliable strategy to preserve and grow wealth, even as markets continue to shift. Málaga: The Innovation and Culture Capital of Southern Europe Málaga real estate market has quickly evolved into one of the most exciting cities in Southern Europe, blending modern innovation with rich cultural history. Here’s how it actually stands out: Málaga seamlessly blends cutting-edge technology with deep-rooted history. As a rising tech hub with thriving startups and global firms, it also boasts historic landmarks and rich Andalusian heritage, offering professionals and innovators a lifestyle where modernity meets timeless culture. 2. Culture, Cuisine, and Coastal Charm From Picasso’s birthplace to vibrant tapas bars, Málaga offers a rich cultural scene, award-winning gastronomy, and Mediterranean beaches. The city’s year-round sunshine enhances its appeal, making it an ideal place to balance work, creativity, and leisure by the sea. 3. title: How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest
description: Investing in high-end real estate offers substantial wealth preservation, capital appreciation, and strong market status.
text: How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest Investing in high-end real estate offers substantial wealth preservation, capital appreciation, and strong market status. However, the luxury market operates under very different rules than traditional residential housing. Standard valuation formulas often fall short because premium properties trade on emotional value, architectural distinction, and geographic exclusivity rather than strictly square footage. To make a profitable acquisition, high-net-worth investors must separate superficial finishes from enduring asset value. Knowing how to properly evaluate luxury property assets requires looking beyond polished marble countertops and stage dressing to assess micro-market demand, architectural authorship, and long-term operating costs. 1. Micro-Market Dynamics and Micro-Location Location is the primary price driver in real estate, but at the luxury tier, performance is strictly hyperlocal. Two estates within the same neighborhood or even two units in the same high-rise can have drastically different valuations based on micro-factors. Sightlines and Orientations: Unobstructed natural views like waterfronts, skylines, golf courses, or mountain ranges command significant price premiums. Verify whether nearby vacant parcels could lead to future construction that blocks your views. Privacy and Setbacks: High-end buyers pay for discretion. Evaluate road noise, traffic patterns, security perimeters, and how the plot protects outdoor living spaces from neighboring sightlines. Neighborhood Liquidity: Analyze historical sales velocity specifically within the immediate micro-district. Thin transaction volumes can inflate listed values until market conditions shift. 2. Architectural Integrity and Floor Plan Ergonomics Decorative interior trends age quickly, but sound spatial architecture holds value over decades. When you evaluate luxury property layouts, look at structural flow and proportions rather than surface styling. Ceiling Heights and Natural Light: Soaring ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glass expanses create an expansive sense of volume that cannot be added through simple renovations. Functional Layouts: Evaluate the relationship between entertaining zones and private family living quarters. Well-planned estates feature dedicated service access, secondary prep kitchens, and secluded primary suites. Indoor-Outdoor Flow: High-end buyers expect direct transitions between indoor living rooms, outdoor terraces, infinity pools, and dining areas. 3. Total Cost of Ownership and Carrying Expenses A frequent mistake when purchasing high-end real estate is focusing solely on the purchase price while ignoring the ongoing carrying costs. Luxury assets carry high operational expenses. HOA and Association Dues: High-rise residences and gated communities feature expensive monthly fees to maintain luxury amenities, staff, and security systems. Insurance Premiums: Coastal, waterfront, and hilltop estates face elevated insurance rates due to flood, wind, or fire risks. Specialized Maintenance: Features like heated pools, private elevators, extensive landscaping, sea walls, and smart home automation require ongoing specialist servicing. The Essential Luxury Investor Checklist Use this structured checklist during site visits and financial due diligence to verify that a property meets high-value investment standards: Micro-Location and Privacy: Confirm sightline protections, noise levels, exposure to natural light, and proximity to elite amenities. Architectural and Build Quality: Inspect foundation integrity, roof condition, weatherproofing, and structural materials. Mechanical and Smart Systems: Audit the age, capacity, and service history of HVAC units, home automation networks, and security infrastructure. Legal and Title Verification: Ensure clear title, confirm boundary lines, verify zoning codes, and check for hidden easements or HOA restrictions. Financial Modeling: Calculate gross acquisition costs, property taxes, specialized insurance, annual upkeep reserves, and projected rental yields. 4. Building Governance and Reserve Funds If you are buying a condominium or a unit within a branded residence, the financial health of the building association is as important as the apartment itself. Reserve Fund Audits: Review the association's financial statements to ensure adequate reserve funds are allocated for capital repairs like facade restorations, elevator overhauls, or roof replacements. Special Assessment History: Check whether unit owners were recently levied large unbudgeted fees for unexpected structural updates. Litigation Status: Verify that the homeowner board or developer is not involved in ongoing lawsuits that could impact property values or mortgage availability. 1. How do I evaluate luxury property pricing when comparable sales are limited? When direct comparable sales are sparse, analyze the price per square foot of recent sales in nearby prime developments, adjust for unique view corridors, and factor in land value plus total reconstruction costs. 2. Should I prioritize custom features or classic architectural styles when buying luxury real estate? Classic architectural styles and versatile floor plans consistently hold value better than highly customized or trend-driven features. Overly personalized finishes often require costly remodeling to appeal to future resale buyers. 3. What is the most overlooked factor on a luxury property checklist? The total annual carrying cost. Buyers often account for the purchase price but overlook ongoing expenses like high HOA dues, specialized property maintenance, staffing, and rising property insurance premiums. 4. Is a professional home inspection necessary for brand-new luxury builds? Yes. Even newly constructed estates can have hidden defects in complex HVAC, plumbing, smart automation, or waterproofing systems. Independent inspections safeguard your capital before final handover. 5. How do smart home systems impact luxury property value? Integrated, modern smart home technology enhances daily livability and security, making properties more attractive on the market. However, outdated proprietary systems can become a liability if replacement parts or updates are unavailable.

title: How to Get a Residence Visa in Dubai 2025: Requirements, Process & Documents
description: Learn how to obtain a Dubai residence visa in 2025, including eligibility, required documents, application process, and how to qualify via property investment.
text: How To Get A Residence Visa In Dubai: 2025 Requirements, Process, And Documents Needed? The UAE is now one of the most popular places to live, work, and invest in 2025. Its amazing infrastructure, tax-free policies, and active business mentality make it an excellent place to reside permanently, and that is why you need a UAE residency visa. This enables you to reside in the UAE for a number of years, offering several residency benefits. We help our prospective investors gain residency visas by purchasing premium properties such as D-Villas At Jumeirah Golf Estates , Trump International Hotel & Tower , Dubai and W Residences in Dubai, offering luxury living and long-term residency. So keep reading and take a step forward in getting a residency visa in the UAE. Dubai attracts foreign residents and investors with a long-term stay, a tax-free environment, and a solid infrastructure. A UAE residence visa enables access, services, and long-term stay, and may be based on employment, business, investment, or family sponsorship. Spend at least AED 2 million on Dubai real estate and get eligible for a 10-year Golden Visa. A visa application involves the preparation of documents, obtaining an entry visa, a medical checkup, and obtaining an Emirates ID. Applicants can check visa status and print visa copies online from official UAE websites using their application or passport numbers. You may also sponsor relatives, with nominal charges of AED 3,000–7,000 and processing times of 2–10 working days. What Is a Residence Visa in the UAE? A UAE residence visa allows foreign nationals to stay, work, or study in the UAE for a period of 2 to 10 years. A residence visa is different from a visit visa, which is meant for temporary stays. Most residence visas have a sponsor, i.e., a company or a UAE resident, who is liable for your stay. However, there are exceptions, such as the Green Visa, Golden Visa, that allow real estate investors, skilled workers, freelancers, and self-employed to sponsor themselves. It is this openness that draws the UAE to a diverse range of applicants, from professionals to investors. Apart from this, you may need other documents depending on your visa type. For example, investors may need proof of property ownership while employees may need an offer letter. The first step to acquiring a residence visa is to arrive in the UAE on an entry permit or an entry visa. This entry visa allows you to remain in the country for a short while as you obtain residency. It is valid for 60 days, which is long enough to undergo medical tests and submit the required documents. Also, it depends on the purpose of your stay, either for work, investment, or sponsorship by family. Arrange a Medical Examination A medical examination is a mandatory requirement for all resident visa applicants 18 years and above. It is conducted at an approved medical facility and tests for certain specified medical conditions. You will need to bring your original passport, entry permit, and a passport-sized photo. The test will take a few days, and you will need a successful medical report before proceeding to the next step. Emirates ID is the UAE's official resident ID card. It is provided by the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship and is given for the same duration as your residence visa is valid. You will need your passport, visa copy, and proof of residence, such as a tenancy agreement. You will also be asked to undergo biometric testing, including fingerprinting and an iris scan. An Emirates ID is needed to get access to government services, a bank account, and to complete official payments. Once you have sent in your entry permit, medical reports, and application for Emirates ID, your sponsor can proceed to make the final application for the residence visa. This step is completed through authorized channels like typing centers or the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA). You can check your UAE residence visa status online via the official ICA Smart Services portal for most emirates or the GDRFA website for Dubai. By providing your application number or passport number, you can check the status of your visa, including whether it is approved, pending, or in progress. How to Get a Residence Visa Copy Online? To get an online printout of your residence visa, visit the ICP Smart Services platform , specifically the website: smartservices.icp.gov.ae, log into your account, and download your visa application. You may print the visa copy, preferably in PDF format. This proves useful in saving a copy of your visa details digitally. In 2025, obtaining a Dubai residence visa remains a straightforward process for investors, professionals, and families, provided you meet the eligibility requirements and prepare the necessary documents. Whether through employment, entrepreneurship, or property investment, the UAE offers multiple visa options that open the door to long-term residency and its many benefits, including access to world-class infrastructure, tax-free earnings, and an exceptional quality of life. Partnering with an experienced developer like DarGlobal ensures not only access to prime real estate but also expert guidance throughout the visa process, making your move to Dubai both smooth and rewarding. It generally takes only 2 to 10 working days from the time the documents are received and the medical evaluation is done. 2: Can I apply for a visa without a job in the UAE? Yes, you can apply for a residency visa without having a job in the UAE through real estate investment, company setup, family sponsorship, or some self-sponsorship visa categories. 3: What’s the difference between a residence visa and a visit visa? A residence visa permits long-term residence and offers several residency benefits like the right to work, education, etc., while a visit visa permits short residence for tourist or short business stays. 4: How to track my UAE visa application status? Yes, you can sponsor your family on a UAE residence visa if you are eligible on the basis of income and accommodation. It is usually around AED 3,000 to AED 7,000, which includes application fees, medical check-up, and Emirates ID. 7: What are the eligibility criteria for an investor residence visa? For an investor residence visa, you must invest in real estate of a minimum worth of AED 2 million or meet other investment requirements as specified by the UAE authorities.

text: Family-Friendly Fun in Dubai: Your Ultimate Guide to a Memorable Saturday Afternoon Dubai , a city renowned for its towering skyscrapers and luxurious lifestyle, is also a treasure trove of family-friendly activities. As you plan your ultimate Saturday afternoon in this vibrant city, rest assured there’s no shortage of fun, excitement, and cherished moments. With its thrilling water slides, relaxing lazy rivers, and a dedicated children’s play area, Aquaventure offers a refreshing start to your day. Don’t miss the opportunity to get up close with marine life in the aquarium or take a dive with the dolphins! 2. text: Investing in Hotel Apartments in Dubai: Opportunities, Returns and Key Locations Over the last few decades, Dubai has become one of the most desirable locations for real estate investments. No rent income and capital gains tax, resulting in higher net income. Expert management ensures hassle-free ownership and maintenance. Flexibility to live in it yourself or rent it out. Strong tourist arrivals and global connectivity support high occupancy. Dubai Marina: A waterfront area that is particularly famous among tourists, especially during peak seasons. Investment Opportunities and Expected Returns The Dubai hotel apartment market offers several opportunities to investors, both locally and globally. These apartments offer good rental income and long-term capital gain. The hotel apartments in Dubai offer 6% to 10% returns per annum, depending on location and project. The high-end locations like Palm Jumeirah and Downtown Dubai offer higher returns. Looking to explore more about real estate opportunities in Dubai? Check out all our Dubai properties to discover prime locations, luxury living, and high-return investments. How to Invest in Hotel Apartments in Dubai (Step-by-Step Guide) Buying hotel apartments involves careful planning and investigation. Working on a planned step-by-step basis reduces risks and increases profit. Step 1: Conduct market surveys to determine costs, objectives, and preferred districts. Step 2: Cross-compare ongoing projects and assess developer reputation and ROI estimates. Step 3: Choose property, inspect contracts, and conduct due diligence. Step 4: Organize finances, make the down payment, and enroll with the Dubai Land Department. Step 5: Receive the title deed and establish rent collection systems. Step 6: Join forces with an experienced management service to optimize income and occupancy. Managing Your Hotel Apartment Investment At the time of acquisition, good management maintains and enhances the value of your hotel apartment. Regular maintenance, refurbishment, and equipment replacement keep the property attractive to tenants. Professional management contracts enable investors to outsource reception booking to in-guest services. Owners also receive short, easy-to-read reports, which enable them to monitor performance and income. Successful hotel apartments not only bring good financial returns but also bring investors peace of mind. Like any investment, hotel apartments also carry risks. Being aware of them helps investors make informed decisions. Market fluctuations may impact resale value and rental demand. Oversupply in local marketplaces can lead to reduced occupancy. Utilities, maintenance, and management fees could lower net income. A construction slowdown or low-quality construction will impact apartment values. Poor management can also reduce profitability. Currency risks may impact international investors' earnings. Comparison: Hotel Apartments vs Other Hotel Real Estate Investments Before making your final decision, it is important to consider other hotel real estate investments and compare them with hotel apartments. So here we have a detailed comparison between both: Hotel Apartments (Serviced) Other Hotel Real Estate (Traditional Hotels) Lower due to smaller scale and fewer facilities Higher due to larger public spaces and amenities Lower, minimal staffing required Higher, larger teams and overhead costs Longer average stays, steady occupancy Shorter stays, higher seasonal swings Higher per-room income potential The owner can use or lease Limited to hotel operations Strong, multiple revenue streams from services More stable, less sensitive to downturns More volatile, dependent on tourism cycles Dubai hotel apartments investment is not just about money; it is also about lifestyle. Through DarGlobal properties , such as Trump International Hotel & Tower, investors gain exposure to centrally located assets that strike a perfect balance between personal enjoyment and regular income. So, when are you investing in the next hotel apartment in Dubai? 1. What is the best location to invest in hotel apartments in Dubai? Some of the prime locations for hotel apartments investment in Dubai are Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. These locations have high demand from tenants, good occupancy, and the potential for long-term value appreciation. 2. How much return can I expect from investing in hotel apartments in Dubai? The returns on investment in hotel apartments in Dubai range from a low of 6% to a high of 10%. The exact income you receive depends on what kind of development is involved, where it is located, and how the property management is structured. 3. Can foreigners own hotel apartments in Dubai Investment Park? Yes, foreigners can own hotel apartments in certain freehold areas. The investor, therefore, gains full ownership rights to purchase, sell, or let out the property without restriction. 4. What are the risks of investing in hotel real estate in Dubai? Investing in hotel apartments in Dubai poses several risks, including oversupply, management issues, and other costs that cannot be calculated. 5. How does investing in hotel apartments compare to other real estate investments? Hotel apartments are a more stable and easily maintained rental income, while traditional hotels can offer greater gross earnings, but at a higher cost and risk level. In the final analysis, whether to invest in hotel apartments or hotels is a decision that depends on your investment goals and tolerance for risk.

title: ROI & ROE in Real Estate Co-Branding | Ziad El Chaar Insights
description: Discover how co-branding boosts ROI and ROE in real estate. Insights from DarGlobal's Ziad El Chaar on exclusive developments.
text: High ROI and ROE, Real Estate Co-branding through the Lens of Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal From Gianni Versace's Vision to Modern-Day Success, Co-Branding Redefines Exclusive Property Developments. In the realm of real estate, co-branding has emerged as a potent strategy that combines the allure of fashion and luxury brands with exclusive property developments. This trend originated in the early 1980s when fashion events paved the way for collaborative initiatives. One of the pioneering figures in this field was the legendary Gianni Versace, who introduced the concept of fashion brand interiors in hotels and mansions. Today, co-branding between real estate and renowned fashion brands has become increasingly prevalent, offering significant value to clients, developers, and the brands involved. In this article, we delve into the insights of Ziad El Chaar, the CEO of DarGlobal, a prominent figure in the real estate industry, as he explores the benefits and impact of co-branding in this domain. Offering Clients Ultimate Exclusivity in the Digital Age In the digital age, our lives have become increasingly public, with social media platforms dominating our daily interactions. Influencers, who shape consumer preferences, have emerged, creating a desire for exclusivity among the masses. Ziad El Chaar emphasizes that co-branded real estate projects cater to this desire, presenting clients with limited edition properties. The exclusivity associated with these collaborations not only offers a high return on investment but also satisfies clients’ innate longing for distinction. By owning an exclusive property associated with a prestigious brand, individuals can fulfill their ego-driven aspirations, feeling part of an elite group. Enabling Developers to offer trust and exclusivity For developers, co-branding brings multiple advantages. First and foremost, it conveys trustworthiness and readibility to potential buyers. Collaborating with well-known brands allows developers to leverage the brand’s reputation and established presence, assuring clients of the project’s quality. Additionally, co-branding enables developers to infuse a sense of exclusivity into large-scale projects. Rather than simply offering a multitude of units, the limited-edition aspect associated with a renowned brand elevates the project’s desirability and allure. This exclusivity contributes to higher returns on investment and increased client interest. Allowing Branding Partners to deepen their connections From the perspective of the co-branding partner, which is typically a fashion or luxury brand, there are numerous benefits to be gained. Engaging in a co-branded real estate project often involves a substantial revenue opportunity, given the high value associated with such developments. However, beyond financial gains, Ziad El Chaar highlights the importance of immersing clients in the brand experience. When individuals reside in a property associated with a particular brand, they form a deeper connection with the brand itself. This enhanced connection allows brands to strengthen their relationship with clients, fostering loyalty and long-term brand engagement. Key Considerations for Successful Co-Branding While co-branding has seen significant growth in recent years, it requires careful consideration and strategic implementation. Merely placing a brand’s stamp on a property is insufficient. Ziad El Chaar emphasizes the importance of aligning the brand’s DNA with the project’s interiors and architecture. By seamlessly transferring the brand’s essence into the physical space, developers can create an authentic and immersive brand experience for residents. Critical elements such as distinctive furniture ranges contribute to the overall co-branded environment. Failing to incorporate these essential components leads to superficial collaborations lacking genuine value. Maintaining Brand Standards and Control Once a co-branded project is delivered to clients, it is crucial to ensure that the brand’s standards are maintained. Owners’ associations play a pivotal role in this regard, as they become responsible for preserving the brand’s integrity within the building or community and adhering to the brand guidelines. To safeguard the brand’s reputation, it is essential for the co-branding partner to establish measures to monitor and control how their brand is being maintained in the property. Should the brand’s standards not be upheld, the brand should not hesitate to take necessary actions, such as withdrawing their association with the project. The Future of Co-Branding in Real Estate As wealth concentration continues to rise globally, the demand for exclusive and luxurious products, including real estate, is on the ascent. Ziad El Chaar predicts substantial growth and an influx of upcoming co-branded projects for brands already engaged in real estate co-branding and those seeking to venture into this domain. With the convergence of fashion, luxury, and real estate, developers have a unique opportunity to tap into the desires of discerning clients who crave exceptional and exclusive living experiences. In the realm of real estate, co-branding has evolved into a compelling strategy that merges the realms of fashion and luxury brands with exclusive property developments. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, emphasizes the significance of co-branding for clients, developers, and branding partners alike. By offering limited edition properties, co-branded real estate projects cater to clients’ longing for exclusivity, providing both financial and ego-driven returns. Developers benefit from the trust and credibility associated with renowned brands, while branding partners deepen their connection with clients through immersive experiences. As co-branding continues to flourish in the real estate industry, strategic implementation and maintaining brand standards will be vital to ensuring the success and longevity of these collaborations. With the promising future ahead, the convergence of co-branding, real estate, and the desires of affluent consumers creates a landscape of endless possibilities for innovative and extraordinary living spaces. Note: The content above is an original creation based on the provided transcript and does not directly quote Ziad El Chaar. It emphasizes his insights and expertise while incorporating relevant information about co-branding in the real estate industry.

description: Navigating luxury real estate demands smart financial planning, cost evaluation, and expert guidance for a successful investment.
text: Unlocking the Door to Your Dream Home: Essential Financial Steps for Homebuyers Navigating the luxury real estate market can be both exhilarating and daunting. Whether you're eyeing a beachfront villa or a chic urban penthouse , the journey to acquiring your dream home involves meticulous financial planning and strategic decision-making. Here, we outline essential financial steps to help you unlock the door to your luxury dream home. 1. Assess Your Financial Health The first step in your luxury home buying journey is to take a comprehensive look at your financial health. This means evaluating your income, savings, investments, and credit score. A strong credit score is crucial in securing favorable mortgage terms, which can significantly impact the overall cost of your luxury property. Consider consulting with a financial advisor to ensure your finances are in optimal shape before diving into the luxury real estate market. 2. Understand the Full Cost of Ownership Luxury homes come with higher costs, beyond the listing price. It's important to factor in property taxes, homeowners insurance, maintenance, and potentially homeowners association fees. Additionally, luxury properties often entail higher costs for utilities and services due to their larger size and premium features. Create a detailed budget that accounts for all these expenses to ensure you're fully prepared for the financial commitment. Given the competitive nature of the luxury real estate market, having your financing in order before making an offer is crucial. Explore different mortgage options and lenders who specialize in luxury properties to find the best fit for your financial situation. Pre-approval for a loan not only gives you a clear idea of your budget but also strengthens your position as a buyer in the eyes of sellers. 4. Consider the Investment Potential Luxury homes are not just places to live; they're also significant investments . Research the market trends and potential for property value appreciation in your targeted area. Some luxury properties might offer better investment potential due to their location, unique features, or development prospects. Consider how the property fits into your long-term financial goals and wealth-building strategies. 5. Work with a Specialized Real Estate Agent Navigating the luxury market requires expertise and insider knowledge. Partner with a real estate agent who specializes in luxury properties. They can provide valuable insights into market trends, help negotiate the best deal, and navigate the complex paperwork and legal requirements involved in purchasing a luxury home. Purchasing a luxury home is a significant financial decision that requires careful planning and consideration. By assessing your financial health, understanding the full cost of ownership, securing financing early, considering the investment potential, and working with a specialized agent, you can confidently move toward acquiring your dream home in the luxury real estate world. With these steps, you're not just buying a property; you're investing in a lifestyle and your future.

title: Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential
description: Learn what is waterfront property, its definition, value, and investment potential. Explore why owning waterfront real estate is a smart and lucrative choice.
text: Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential Owning a house near the water was considered the ultimate goal of real estate. In fact, waterfront properties not only appeal with beautiful views but also convey an entirely different concept to the real estate market. They signify a rare investment with the potential for financial as well as lifestyle gains. Waterfront real estates that are directly adjacent to water bodies with immediate shoreline access are known to have 30-150% higher prices than those of comparable inland properties. Among these, oceanfront properties are the ones that have the highest premiums (100%+), followed by lakefront (40-60%) and riverfront (25-40%) locations. The top investment destinations are the French Riviera, the Caribbean, Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Oman and Qatar, which are offering a strong potential for appreciation. There are some additional costs that buyers need to be aware of, such as elevated flood insurance, 1.5 to 2 times higher maintenance expenses, and increased property taxes. On the other hand, the investment benefits are, among others, consistent above market appreciation, a strong potential for rental income, and a hedge against inflation due to limited supply. What is Waterfront Property? Waterfront property refers to real estate that is situated right next to a water body and thus, has unmediated access to the shore. Such properties cover areas where living spaces or estates are located alongside seas, lakes, rivers, canals, or bays. The main factor that differentiates waterfront properties is the direct touch or contact with water, not merely seeing it from afar. Real waterfront properties have the privilege of a personal water connection, which can be through a beach, a pier, or the direct shore. Such a difference dramatically affects the worth of the property as well as the owner's way of life. Types of Waterfront Properties Oceanfront Properties: Those are the ones that are literally on the beach and have access to the beach, and they usually cost the most money. Lakefront Homes: Real estate surrounding clean and pure lakes that allow the owners to build docks for themselves and also enjoy the tranquillity of the waters. Riverfront Estates: Residences built on rivers that have views of running water and access to the water for navigation. Canalfront Properties: These are the ones that provide access to the waterway, as well as private boat slips. Waterfront Property Value Premium Analysis How much does waterfront add to property value? Usually, waterfront properties will cost 30% to 150% more than equivalent non-waterfront properties, the main factors determining the difference being the location and the water type. Seaside properties are the ones that are the most expensive; their extra cost is, therefore, frequently double or even more than that of similar properties. In contrast, the value of a property exposed to a lake only rises by 40 to 60%, while a property on the bank of a river is worth 25 to 40% more. Waterfront Property Pricing and Cost Analysis How much does waterfront property cost? Prices can be very different at different places. For example, oceanfront properties in luxury markets can cost anywhere between $2 million and more than $50 million, whereas lakefront homes in the less expensive areas may be available for half a million dollars. Understanding how much waterfront property is worth, it is necessary to look at the sales of similar properties, the quality of the water, and other factors related to the location. Popular Waterfront Property Locations Where to buy waterfront property is decided by what you seek to achieve with your investment and your lifestyle preferences: Mediterranean Coast: Southern France, Italian Riviera, Greek Islands Caribbean Islands: Always attractive with lively rental markets U.S. Coastal Markets: Florida, California, Hamptons European Lakes: Lake Como, Lake Geneva Dubai & Ras Al Khaimah: High-end developments with tax-free advantages and top-notch facilities Oman: Unspoiled coastlines with the development of luxury resort communities Qatar: Ultra-luxury waterfront developments in a rapidly expanding market There are also emerging markets in Southeast Asia and the Middle East that offer the potential for growth. Waterfront Property Investment Analysis Is buying waterfront property a good investment? In the past, waterfront real estate has been a major winner in value increase; most of the time, its growth rate is twice that of non-waterfront properties. Continued value increase at a rate higher than the general market Good cash flow potential from rentals Protection against inflation by investing in real, tangible assets The luxury factor is keeping demand at a high level. It takes choosing the right market and understanding that you will have higher maintenance costs. Benefits and Lifestyle Advantages Homes with waterfronts are the best way to enjoy a lifestyle. With direct water access, it is easy to have fun swimming, boating, and fishing. The peaceful atmosphere helps one to be healthy; meanwhile, the unique communities give privacy and status. Such reasons are behind the steady desire for these properties; thus, they become a safe bet in terms of their value in the future. Insurance and Maintenance Considerations It is common for flood insurance to be mandatory, and the amount of money can be very large, particularly in the case of properties facing the ocean. In most cases, water damage is excluded from a standard policy; thus, a separate coverage is needed. The reasons behind these are saltwater corrosion as well as the high moisture content in the air. Plan to spend 1.5 to 2 times what you would spend on the maintenance of an inland property. Waterfront real estate is a special example of the convergence of the sophisticated lifestyle, a luxurious trend, and investment opportunities. This trio of elements, limited supply, steady demand, and lifestyle attractiveness, ensures high profits for smart investors. DarGlobal provides investors with privileged access to a select few of the most luxurious waterfront lifestyle developments across the world, such as The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin And Trump Cliff Villas . Every project is a balanced blend of outstanding design, a waterfront of the highest calibre, and extremely attractive investment prospects, a new era of luxury lifestyle, making profitable and safe investment choices aligned with the vision of smart investors. What exactly qualifies as waterfront property, and how is it different from water view property? Waterfront property is a property that has direct contact with water and access to the shoreline. Water view property only has views from afar and no access, thus, the premiums are lower. How much more does waterfront property cost compared to similar inland properties? Waterfront properties are 30% to 150% more expensive, with the highest premiums (100%+) being for oceanfront properties, lakefront (40-60%), and riverfront (25-40%). Is waterfront property a good long-term investment? Yes, waterfront properties increase in value much quicker than inland ones due to their limited supply and constant demand. What are the main risks and additional costs of owning waterfront property? The major risks are flood damage, erosion, and storms. Besides that, the costs will also include more expensive insurance, higher maintenance, and increased property taxes. Where are the best places to buy waterfront property for investment purposes? The top markets are the French Riviera, the Caribbean islands, the Florida coastline, Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Oman, Qatar, and the rapidly developing areas in Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

امسح رمز الإستجابة السريعة وحمّل التطبيق تواصل مع العملاء وأدر أعملاك بكل سهولة! وصلت - رائدة الخدمات العقارية في السعودية أول منصة عقار سعودية بالذكاء الاصطناعي! وصلت هي منصة عقارية سعودية تُسهّل عليك اكتشاف العقارات، واستكشاف الفرص، والتواصل مع خبراء العقار في جميع أنحاء المملكة. سواء كنت تبحث عن الشراء أو الإيجار أو البيع أو الاستثمار، توفر لك وصلت العقارات المناسبة، والمعلومات، والخدمات في مكان واحد. منصة مرخصة من الهيئة العامة للعقار منصة مرخصة من وزارة السياحة الأسئلة الشائعة حول وصلت والخدمات المقدمة ما هي منصة وصلت؟ وصلت هي منصة رائدة في المملكة العربية السعودية للخدمات العقارية الإلكترونية، مرخّصة من الهيئة العامة للعقار (REGA). كيف يمكنني الإعلان عن عقاري على وصلت؟ للإعلن عن عقارك على وصلت، قم أولاً بإنشاء حساب، ثم أدخل تفاصيل العقار، وارفع الصور، وحدد السعر. يمكنك تنفيذ ذلك بسهولة عبر تطبيق وصلت، أو تطبيق وصلت أعمال، أو من خلال الموقع الإلكتروني. كيف اسجل الدخول إلى حسابي على وصلت؟ اضغط على أيقونة الملف الشخصي (أعلى اليسار في الموقع أو عبر القائمة الجانبية في التطبيق)، ثم أدخل رقم الجوال وأكمل عملية التحقق. ما هي مزادات وصلت؟ مزادات وصلت هي خدمة تتيح بيع الأصول العقارية عبر مزادات إلكترونية محددة بوقت، حيث يتنافس المزايدون للوصول إلى السعر النهائي للبيع. وتشمل المزادات أصولاً من ملاك أفراد وأخرى بالتعاون مع مركز الإسناد والتصفية (إنفاذ). ما هي خدمة الطلبات العقارية وكيف تعمل؟ تساعدك خدمة الطلبات العقارية في العثور على العملاء المحتملين بناءً على إعلاناتك النشطة، حيث تتم مطابقة الطلبات وفق نوع العقار، والغرض منه، والحي، وتصنيف العقار. وبعد نشر إعلانك، ستظهر لك الطلبات المتوافقة لتسهيل التواصل مع العملاء المناسبين. ما هي الخدمات العقارية التي تقدمها وصلت؟ وصلت منصة عقارية مدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي للعقارات الموثقة، والمشاريع، والمخططات الرئيسية، والمزادات الإلكترونية، والإيجارات اليومية، مع توفير تجربة بحث متطورة تساعد المستخدمين على العثور على منازلهم المثالية بسهولة. أشهر المدن والعقارات في السعودية عقارات الرياض، جدة، مكة وغيرها من المدن الأخرى عقارات للايجار في السعودية

text: شروط وأحكام خدمة الإعلان العقاري تشكل وثيقة شروط وأحكام خدمة الإعلان العقاري هذه ("شروط وأحكام الإعلان") عقداً ملزماً فيما بين شركة وصلت للخدمات العقارية صاحبة سجل تجاري رقم 1010635634 وترخيص وساطة رقم 1200016591 وترخيص منصة رقم 2100000377 ("الشركة") والمُعلن -معرّف أدناه- وتحدد مسؤوليات الطرفين. على المُعلن قراءة الشروط والأحكام بعناية قبل استخدامه للموقع الإلكتروني. ويعني دخوله و/أو استخدامه و/أو الاستفادة من أي خدمة و/أو ميزة و/أو محتوى و/أو منفعة يوفره الموقع الالكتروني أو يتوفر من خلاله، قبولاً من جانب المُعلن بالالتزام بشروط وأحكام الإعلان هذه والشروط والأحكام العامة للاستخدام وسياسة الخصوصية ("الشروط والأحكام") وإقراراً بعلمه علم نافياً للجهالة وموافقته على الالتزام بها. الأنظمة واللوائح المعمول بها: هي اللوائح والأنظمة ذات الصلة النافذة في المملكة العربية السعودية. الإعلان: يقصد به إعلان الوحدة العقارية المدرج على الموقع الإلكتروني والذي ينقسم لعده لفئات مفصله أدناه. الإعلان الرئيسي : هو الإعلان العقاري للوحدة العقارية في الموقع الإلكتروني الذي يتم من خلاله السماح للزائرين بمشاهدته وإبداء اهتماماهم. إعلان مميز: هو الإعلان العقاري للوحدة العقارية في الموقع الإلكتروني والذي يظهر للزائرين عند البحث عن وحدة عقارية بحي أو منطقة معينة. إعلان مميز بلس: هو الإعلان العقاري للوحدة العقارية في الموقع الإلكتروني والذي يظهر للزائرين عند البحث عن وحدة عقارية بحي أو منطقة أو مدينة معينة، كما يظهر كدبوس ذهبي عند استعراض الوحدات العقارية في الخريطة. الرسوم : هي الرسوم التي يدفعها المُعلن بغرض الإعلان عن الوحده عقارية والمفصلة في البند السادس من شروط وأحكام الإعلان هذه. فترة الإعلان: هي الفترة التي يتم من خلالها نشر الإعلان في الموقع الإلكتروني، ومدتها ثلاثون (30) من تاريخ النشر. المُعلن: الشخص الطبيعي والمعنوي الذي يقوم باستخدام الموقع الإلكتروني سواء كان مالكاً للوحدة العقارية أو مفوضاً بالإعلان عنها. الموقع الإلكتروني: موقع "وصلت" ويشمل تطبيق الهاتف الجوال الخاص بنا. الوحدة العقارية: يقصد بها الأرض أو الفلة أو الشقة أو العمارة أو الدور أو الدبلكس أو القصر أو غيره الخاصة بالمُعلن محل الإعلان. بأنه يتمتع بالأهلية المتعبرة نظاماً وشرعاً -في حال كان شخصاً طبيعياً متصرفاً نيابة عن نفسه - وأنه مُنشأ ومُعترف به نظامياً -في حال كان شخصاً اعتبارياً للقيام بالإعلان. كما يقر المُعلن في حال تصرفه نيابة عن غيره أنه مخول ولديه الصلاحية للتصرف نيابة عن شخص آخر سواء طبيعي أم اعتباري. بتحري الصدق والأمانة في الإعلان. بالإبتعاد عن كل ما يسبب التباساً أو تضليلاً للعموم والالتزام بصحة المعلومات المدخلة. بتطبيق ما يصدر به الدليل العام لضوابط المحتوى الإعلاني. بما يصدر من الجهات المختصة بتنظيم المحتوى الأخلاقي والإعلامي بجميع وسائطه المعلوماتية (التقليدية والإلكترونية). باستخدام الأسماء الرسمية للمدن والأحياء والشوارع وأنواع العقارات ويجوز إضافة الأسماء المتعارف عليها. بأن يكون غرض الإعلان للبيع أو التأجير فقط. بمطابقة الصور المدرجة في الإعلان للوحدة العقارية في الواقع. ويفهم بأنه وحده مسؤول عن إدراج الإعلان في الموقع الإلكتروني ومتابعته وتصفحه وتحديثه خلال فترة الإعلان ويدخل من ضمن ذلك تمديد فترة الإعلان الرئيسي. بأنه وحده مسؤول أمام المشتري و/أو المستأجر فيما يتعلق بعدم صحة البيانات والمعلومات المذكورة في الإعلان. بأن الوحدة العقارية سليمة وخالية من العيوب الجوهرية والمخلة بغرض الاستفادة منها، وأنها مستوفيه للتصاريح الرسمية، وأنها غير مقيده بأي اتفاق أو أعباء مالية أو رهن أو نزاعات قد تعيق أو تؤثر على البيع أو الإيجار وفي حال خلاف ذلك فالمعلن يقر بأنه ملزم بالإفصاح عن ذلك بشكل واضح في الإعلان. يحظر نشر الإعلانات العقارية الوهمية لغرض جمع بيانات المتلقين أو العموم أو أي غرض آخر. يوافق المُعلن على دفع رسوم الإعلان للشركة (شركة وصلت للخدمات العقارية) عند تنفيذ أي عملية بيع أو تأجير على العملاء الذين تم وصولهم إلى المُعلن/الاعلان عن طريق استخدام أو زيارة الموقع الإلكتروني. كما يوافق المُعلن بأن تكون افادة العميل بهذا الخصوص نهائية وملزمة. يقر المُعلن بعدم إرسال أو محاولة إرسال أي فيروسات حاسوبية أو عيوب أو أي مواد تدميرية أخرى ، أو رفع أو نشر أو إرسال أو بث أو أي وسيلة أخرى تتيح أية معلومات على، أو من خلال، الموقع الإلكتروني والتي قد تكون مضرة أو تهديدية أو منافية للآداب العامة. يقر المُعلن بعدم القيام بأي عملية آلية للتدخل في أو محاولة التدخل في طريقة العمل السليمة للموقع الإلكتروني أو القيام بأي فعل يكون من شأنه فرض حمل كبير بشكل غير منطقي أو غير متناسب مع البنية التحتية المتاحة. يقر المُعلن بعدم القيام بهندسة عكسية، أو جمع عكسي، أو تفكيك، أو عمل آخر من شأنه اكتشاف الصيغ الحسابية أو المعالجات فيما يخص برنامج الحاسوب المستخدم في البنية التحتية والعمليات المتعلقة بالموقع الإلكتروني. يقر المُعلن بعدم نسخ، أو إعادة إنتاج/أو تغيير، أو تعديل، أو اشتقاق أعمال من محتوى الموقع الإلكتروني دون الموافقة الخطية المسبقة من قِبل الشركة سواء خلال مدة الإعلان في الموقع الإلكتروني أو بعد انتهاء فترة الإعلان. يقر المُعلن بإبلاغ الشركة فوراّ إذا استشعر أو أيقن بأن شخص غير مصرح له يستخدم الموقع الإلكتروني بحسابه الخاص أو شك في أي خرق للأمن. يقر المُعلن بأنه لن يقوم بجمع معلومات عن الموقع الإلكتروني أو مستخدميه الآخرين لأغراض خاصة أو استخدام الموقع الإلكتروني لأي أغراض تجارية خاصة أو أعمال تجارية لم توافق الشركة عليها صراحة خطياً. يقر المُعلن بأنه ليس من موظفي الشركة أو ممثليها أو تابع لها وأن استخدام الموقع الإلكتروني لا يشكل أي نوع من الوكالة أو الشراكة بين المُعلن والشركة ولا يحق له بالتصرف نيابة عن الشركة أو تمثيلها بأي شكل من الأشكال. يتعهد المُعلن ببذل كل الجهود في استخدام الموقع الإلكتروني وحمايته من أي استخدام غير مصرح به أو قد يسبب ضرراً بالشركة وفي حال ثبت عدم التزامه بهذا البند أو أي من بنود الشروط والأحكام، فإنه سيتحمل كامل المسؤولية تجاه الشركة والجهات المعنية ذات الصلة وسيقوم بتعويضها عن جميع هذه الأضرار الحالية أو المستقبلية. يقر المُعلن بفهمه ويوافق أن الشركة لا تضمن أن ينتج بيعاً أو ايجاراً للوحدة العقارية بعد إدارج الإعلان وأنه لا يحق له الرجوع على الشركة في حال لم ينتج عنه شيئاً. يجب أن يحتوي الإعلان على البيانات التالية: النص على كونه إعلاناً (يمكن ذكر ذلك في الوصف) تحديد الغرض من الإعلان (بيع، إيجار). تحديد نوع الوحدة العقارية ( شقة، فلة، أرض، عمارة... إلخ) وبياناتها بالتفصيل كما هو منصوص عليه في البند رابعاً أدناه. اسم المُعْلِن كاملا وصفته (مالك، مفوض). رقم رخصة الوساطة والتسويق العقاري إن كان مكتبا أو مسوقا عقاريا أو حاصلا على وثيقة عمل حر. موقع الوحدة العقارية على أن يحتوي –بحد أدنى- (المدينة – الحي – رقم المخطط إن وجد). وسيلة تواصل فعالة مع المُعلن. يمتنع المُعلن تضمين الإعلان العقاري لأي مما يأتي: انتهاك حقوق الملكية الفكرية. التعرض بصورة سلبية للمنافسين أو منشآت القطاع الخاص أو غيرها عبارات أو إشارات يفهم منها التمييز ضد أحد كان. صورا أو بيانات أو موقعا أو مناظير مضللة أو لا تخص العقار المعلن عنه. شعار الهيئة العامة للعقار أو اسمها أو أي من الجهات الحكومية الأخرى إلا بإذن مسبق منها. النزاعات القائمة بشأنها إن وجدت. الرهن أو القيد الذي يمنع أو يحد من التصرف أو الانتفاع بالوحدة العقارية. الحقوق والالتزامات على الوحدة العقارية غير الموثقة في وثيقة العقار -في حال وجود اتفاق مكتوب غير مذكور في الصك مثلا. الخدمات المتعلقة بالوحدة العقارية. المعلومات التي قد تؤثر في الوحدة العقارية سواء بخفض قيمته أو التأثير عليها أو على قرار المستهدف بالإعلان، مثل الضمانات ومددها ومطابقة كود البناء السعودي والعمر للعقار القائم وغير ذلك. ان كان الإعلان عن مزاد عقاري يجب –إضافة الى ما يصدر من الجهات ذات العلاقة- أن يتضمن رقم ترخيص المزاد ومكانه وشروطه والموعد المحدد لإقامته ومدته الزمنية والموعد النهائي –إن وجد- للتقدم للمزاد. وصف الوحدة العقارية بما يشمل نوعه وعمره ومحتوياته وأي وصف مؤثر مثل عرض الشارع الواقع عليه وواجهة الوحدة العقارية وغيرها. حدود وأطوال الوحدة العقارية. ثمن الوحدة العقارية بالريال السعودي. يقوم المعُلن في حال رغبته بالقيام بإعلان رئيسي للوحدة العقارية الخاصة به بإرسال طلب الإعلان للشركة لتقوم بدراسته ويتضمن الطلب تزويد الشركة بجميع المستندات المطلوبة. يوافق المُعلن بأن قبول الإعلان الرئيسي أو رفضه خاضع لموافقة الشركة وحدها. في حال موافقة الشركة على الإعلان، يلتزم المُعلن بسداد رسوم الإعلان بعد إتمام عملية البيع أو الإيجار وفقا للقيمة المحددة في البند السادس من شروط وأحكام الإعلان هذه. يمكن للمُعلن طلب ترقية الإعلان الرئيسي إلى : إعلان مميز أو إعلان مميز بلس ( إن كان مالكا للوحدة العقارية)؛ أو طلب ترقية الإعلان إلىى إعلان مميز (إن كان مفوضا بالإعلان عن مالك الوحدة العقارية). يوافق المُعلن أن الإعلان المميز والإعلان المميز بلس لوحدة عقارية واحدة فقط ولا يمكن إيقافه مؤقتاً وإعادة إدارجة أو نقله لوحدة عقارية أخرى بعد بدء سريانه ولكن يحق له إلغاءه دون استرداد أي من الرسوم المدفوعة. يوافق المعلن ويقر على استخدام الإعلان المميز والإعلان المميز بلس خلال 6 أشهر من تاريخ سداد الرسوم ("صلاحية الإعلان") وفي حال لم يقم بإستخدامه في تلك الفقرة، فلا يحق له المطالبة بإسترداد الرسوم أو طلب تعويض أو طلب منح مدة زمنية إضافية لإستخدام الإعلان المميز أوالمميز بلس. في حال موافقة الشركة على الإعلان، تُدفع رسوم الإعلان وفق الاسعار المحددة بتاريخ الاشتراك عن كل فئة والظاهرة للمًعلن ويتم سدادها : بعد إتمام البيع
